privateVars.name: prisma
privateVars.description: Prisma database service for all list CRUD operations

privateVars.name: connectionsManager
privateVars.description: Manager used to sync list entries with external providers (AniList, MAL, etc.)

privateVars.name: statsService
privateVars.description: Service used to recalculate user stats after list mutations

functions.name: getAnimeList
functions.description: Gets a user's anime list with filtering (status, search, format, genres, year, mediaStatus), sorting, pagination, and privacy checks
returnValues: Promise<{ entries: ListEntity[]; counts: Record<string, number> }>

functions.name: getAnimeListEntry
functions.description: Gets a single anime list entry by username and animeId
returnValues: Promise<any>

functions.name: upsertAnimeList
functions.description: Creates or updates an anime list entry with status, progress, score, dates, notes, rewatched count, and optional connection sync
returnValues: Promise<{ success: boolean; message: string; error?: any }>

functions.name: deleteAnimeList
functions.description: Deletes an anime list entry and syncs deletion with external provider connections
returnValues: Promise<{ success: boolean; message: string; error?: any }>

functions.name: getMangaList
functions.description: Gets a user's manga list with filtering, sorting, pagination, and privacy checks
returnValues: Promise<{ entries: ListEntity[]; counts: Record<string, number> }>

functions.name: getMangaListEntry
functions.description: Gets a single manga list entry by username and mangaId
returnValues: Promise<any>

functions.name: upsertMangaList
functions.description: Creates or updates a manga list entry with status, chapters, volumes, score, dates, notes, reread count, and optional connection sync
returnValues: Promise<{ success: boolean; message: string; error?: any }>

functions.name: deleteMangaList
functions.description: Deletes a manga list entry and syncs deletion with external provider connections
returnValues: Promise<{ success: boolean; message: string; error?: any }>

functions.name: getMovieList
functions.description: Gets a user's movie list with filtering, sorting, pagination, and privacy checks
returnValues: Promise<{ entries: ListEntity[]; counts: Record<string, number> }>

functions.name: getMovieListEntry
functions.description: Gets a single movie list entry by username and tvdbId
returnValues: Promise<any>

functions.name: upsertMovieList
functions.description: Creates or updates a movie list entry with status, score, dates, notes, rewatched count, and optional connection sync
returnValues: Promise<{ success: boolean; message: string; error?: any }>

functions.name: deleteMovieList
functions.description: Deletes a movie list entry and syncs deletion with external provider connections
returnValues: Promise<{ success: boolean; message: string; error?: any }>

functions.name: getTvList
functions.description: Gets a user's TV list with filtering, sorting, pagination, and privacy checks; calculates total episodes from seasons JSON
returnValues: Promise<{ entries: ListEntity[]; counts: Record<string, number> }>

functions.name: getTvListEntry
functions.description: Gets a single TV list entry by username and tvdbId, including watched episodes
returnValues: Promise<any>

exceptions.name: rrNotFoundException
exceptions.message: TV show not found in list

functions.name: upsertTvList
functions.description: Creates or updates a TV list entry with status, score, dates, notes, rewatched count, watched episodes, and optional connection sync
returnValues: Promise<{ success: boolean; message: string; error?: any }>

functions.name: deleteTvList
functions.description: Deletes a TV list entry and syncs deletion with external provider connections
returnValues: Promise<{ success: boolean; message: string; error?: any }>

functions.name: toggleEpisodeWatched
functions.description: Toggles a single TV episode's watched status; creates or deletes the watched episode record and syncs connections
returnValues: Promise<{ watched: boolean }>

functions.name: toggleSeasonWatched
functions.description: Toggles an entire season's episodes as watched or unwatched; upserts or deletes episode records and syncs connections
returnValues: Promise<{ success: boolean }>

functions.name: getGameList
functions.description: Gets a user's game list with filtering, sorting, pagination, and privacy checks; computes mediaStatus from release date
returnValues: Promise<{ entries: ListEntity[]; counts: Record<string, number> }>

functions.name: getGameListEntry
functions.description: Gets a single game list entry by username and gameId
returnValues: Promise<any>

functions.name: upsertGameList
functions.description: Creates or updates a game list entry with status, progress, score, dates, and notes
returnValues: Promise<{ success: boolean; message: string; error?: any }>

functions.name: deleteGameList
functions.description: Deletes a game list entry and recalculates user stats
returnValues: Promise<{ success: boolean; message: string; error?: any }>

functions.name: getBookList
functions.description: Gets a user's book list with filtering, sorting, pagination, and privacy checks; computes mediaStatus from publish year
returnValues: Promise<{ entries: ListEntity[]; counts: Record<string, number> }>

functions.name: getBookListEntry
functions.description: Gets a single book list entry by username and bookId
returnValues: Promise<any>

functions.name: upsertBookList
functions.description: Creates or updates a book list entry with status, chapters, volumes, score, dates, and notes
returnValues: Promise<{ success: boolean; message: string; error?: any }>

functions.name: deleteBookList
functions.description: Deletes a book list entry and recalculates user stats
returnValues: Promise<{ success: boolean; message: string; error?: any }>

functions.name: getWatchingList
functions.description: Gets all currently in-progress media entries (anime WATCHING, manga READING, tv WATCHING, game PLAYING, book READING) sorted by last updated
returnValues: Promise<ListEntity[]>

functions.name: incrementProgress
functions.description: Increments progress for a media entry; auto-completes if max reached, syncs connections, and recalculates stats. TV mode finds next unwatched episodes.
returnValues: Promise<{ success: boolean; message: string; data?: any }>

functions.name: getUserListFilters
functions.description: Gets available filter options (genres, years, formats, statuses) for a user's list of a given media type
returnValues: Promise<{ genres: string[]; years: number[]; formats: string[]; statuses: string[] }>
